title: "S2 - Data inventory"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S2 (inventory).
**Purpose:** record, for every CAMELS-IND gauge, how much streamflow exists,
where it sits in time, how often flow is zero, and how long the interior gaps
are. This table is the evidence base for the screening funnel; nothing here is
filled, smoothed or repaired.
**Inputs:** `output/inventory.csv` (written by `R/run_pipeline.R`, stage S2).
**Outputs:** none (this notebook asserts and documents the upstream table).
**Parameters:** `P$max_short_gap`, `P$long_gap_exclusion`, `P$seed`
(`R/config.R`).

## Load and check schema

```{r}
inv <- nb_require("inventory.csv", "S2")
nb_assert_cols(inv,
  c("gauge_id", "n_obs", "first_date", "last_date", "zero_frac",
    "interior_gap_days", "mean_q", "area_km2", "basin"),
  "inventory")
nb_assert(nrow(inv) > 400, "inventory should cover all CAMELS-IND gauges")
nb_assert(all(is.na(inv$zero_frac) |
                (inv$zero_frac >= 0 & inv$zero_frac <= 1)),
          "zero_frac outside [0,1]")
nb_assert(all(is.na(inv$interior_gap_days) | inv$interior_gap_days >= 0),
          "negative interior gap")
knitr::kable(head(inv[order(-n_obs)], 12), digits = 3,
             caption = "Twelve gauges with the most observed days")
```

## Coverage and gap summary

```{r}
cat(sprintf("gauges: %d   basins: %d\n", nrow(inv), data.table::uniqueN(inv$basin)))
cat(sprintf("observed days per gauge: min %d, median %d, max %d\n",
            min(inv$n_obs), as.integer(median(inv$n_obs)), max(inv$n_obs)))
cat(sprintf("zero fraction: median %.3f, 90th percentile %.3f\n",
            median(inv$zero_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
            unname(quantile(inv$zero_frac, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE))))
cat(sprintf("interior gaps > 30 days: %d gauges\n",
            sum(inv$interior_gap_days > 30, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

`[measurement]` The inventory records zeros rather than deleting them. How a
zero is treated is a *separate, audited decision* (stage S2 zero audit, then
variants V0/V1/V2); the inventory only reports that zeros exist.

`[assumption]` `interior_gap_days` is the longest run of missing days between
the first and last observation, not a calendar span from 1981. A gauge whose
record starts late therefore shows a small interior gap but a short usable
period; the selection step applies an explicit both-period coverage rule on
top of this table.
